fields.label: Tether Address
fields.description: unix:/path, tcp:host:port or an http(s) URL. Blank uses TETHER_ADDR or the default socket.

fields.label: Tether token file
fields.description: Absolute path (or ~/) of a private 0600 file holding the bearer token. Blank falls back to the environment variable, then no credential.

fields.label: Read-only
fields.description: When on, only read verbs are offered. Turn off to enable catalog and registry writes; Tether still refuses catalog plan, apply and reload from a remote device.
